sections.heading: Residency tests
sections.text:
Work out if you're an Australian resident or a foreign resident for tax purposes using the residency tests.

QC72764

Access secure services, view your details and lodge online.

The resides test is the primary test for working out if you're a resident of Australia for tax purposes.

The domicile test is one of the tests used to determine if you're a resident of Australia for tax purposes.

The 183-day test is one of the tests used to determine if you are a resident of Australia for tax purposes.

The superannuation test is one of the tests used to determine if you are a resident of Australia for tax purposes.

These examples may help you determine whether you are a resident of Australia for income tax purposes.
